lane_contract.dependency_rule: Keep N00 and all historical N01-N11 evidence PRE-ADOPTION-SOURCE/noneligible until N00 atomically adopts the graph. After adoption, N02 full inventory closure and re-observation must precede N03; the scheduler frontier is N04-N07 after N03, N09 after N02+N05, N08 after N04-N07, N10 after N03+N06+N09, N11 after N06+N07+N08, and N12 after N10+N11.
lane_contract.scope_rule: Use only graph write scopes. Root-only nodes have empty scope_ids and fail closed. N13 is read-only multi-scope.
lane_contract.lease_rule: P0 may issue only its exact root-debt repair lease. Every non-P0 lease requires the adopted current epoch, compile/namespace/standards observations bound to an already-existing exact source base rather than the containing lease-authority commit, a ready-or-later pre-handoff lane, integrated exact dependency identities, and owned files/generated outputs/fixtures confined to reconciled semantic roots. Four-persona exposure gates only product, signoff, release, and completion. Any consumed-set intersection or upstream identity change invalidates; refresh only clean lanes at a root integration boundary and never externally rebase a dirty lane.
lane_contract.ref_rule: Resolve all eight source refs as one current byte set; stale, missing, historical, or partial refs block selection.
lane_contract.retention_rule: Never broad-delete .codex-worktree while unique fixture repositories or retained home/tmp evidence exist.

lease_record.invalidation_rule: invalidate on any consumed-set intersection or upstream identity change
lease_record.rebase_rule: refresh only from a clean lane at a root integration boundary; dirty lanes are never externally rebased
lease_record.git_metadata_rule: normalize absolute paths and symlinks, resolve linked-worktree gitdir, and protect .git files, gitdir targets, and gitdir refs
lease_record.overlap_rule: normalize paths, symlinks, and gitdir metadata; fail closed on owned file/symbol/generated/fixture/effect/root overlap
lease_record.teardown_retention: retain only unique evidence; remove reproducible worktree state after handoff

prelaunch.p0: root_only; issuance atomically snapshots exact current diagnostics into allowed paths and does not promote a claim
prelaunch.candidate: persist only an already-existing observation boundary; derive the containing clean HEAD/tree during validation and never serialize it into its own candidate bytes

retention_policy.retention_rule: Only classified reproducible target/cache/scratch may be deleted after unique evidence and active leases are absent.

selection: Board/plan are routing projections; stale branches/plans are history-only tombstones.
